name: Catholic Cross References — the Haydock seed
stage: seed 2 — the cross references of Haydock's Catholic Bible: its printed marginal references and the Scripture citations in Fr. Haydock's verse-by-verse commentary notes, parsed and verified
license: This dataset is public domain (see the repository LICENSE, the Unlicense). The Haydock Bible and commentary (1811–1814) are public domain.

seed_source.what: The cross references of the Douay-Rheims Bible with commentary by the Rev. George Leo Haydock (1811–1814): (a) the references printed in its margins, and (b) the Scripture citations embedded in Haydock's per-verse commentary notes.
seed_source.data: Transcribed verse-by-verse at haydockcommentary.com; pinned snapshot of 1,267 of 1,335 chapter pages taken 2026-11-03 (68 pages are absent from the site — see notes). Every parsed target was verified for existence against the pinned original-Douay-Rheims corpus, and exact duplicates of the first seed and of the project's own layer were removed before staging.
seed_source.corpus: github.com/janvier-s/original-douay-rheims, commit d82b2852d55a2ab8f0e57311ee42acde25740781, folder bible/tagged/ (verification corpus, as for seed 1)

notes: Book names and numbering are the Douay-Rheims own (1–4 Kings, Paralipomenon, Esdras, Isaias, Jeremias, Ezechiel, Osee, Micheas, Sophonias, Aggeus, Zacharias, Malachias, Tobias, Ecclesiasticus, Machabees, Apocalypse; Psalms in Vulgate numbering) — the same conventions as the first seed.
A target with no verse (e.g. "Genesis 22") cites the whole chapter, as Haydock cited it.

Each entry names its stream(s): "margin" (the printed marginal cross references of the Haydock Bible) and/or "notes" (a citation inside Haydock's commentary note on the verse, including the New Testament pages' editorial footnotes). Entries attested by both streams are merged once, with both raw texts preserved under raw_by_stream.

Coverage: 1,267 of the 1,335 chapter pages of the transcription were captured. Absent from the site: Psalms 78–87, Jeremias 4–52, and 1 Peter 1–5 (chapters 2–4 return 404; chapter 1 is an empty shell and chapter 5 redirects to it), the empty-shell page 3 Kings 1, and single chapters 2 Machabees 6, Tobias 15, and Ecclesiastes 12. The archive.org OCR of the printed Haydock was assessed as a fallback and rejected: its garbled note headings, abbreviated citation forms, and scrambled margins cannot meet this dataset's verification standard (see stage-haydock/ocr-fallback-assessment.md). No reference in this file comes from OCR.
Candidates that failed verification or parsing were set aside with reasons (stage-haydock/set-asides/), never corrected by guessing.
